probe.direction: Finds that playbook-pd-cross-coupling-scope already encodes this and gives its ordered rule rather than inventing a parallel one: bulkier biaryl phosphine → higher L:Pd → degas harder → only then more heat, with the reason (oxidative addition responds to ligand sterics far more than to temperature, and heat accelerates boronic-acid decomposition — see failure-aqueous-protodeboronation). Recording a refinement is welcome, and must be described as machine-written rather than as settled practice. Presenting a fresh invention while ignoring the existing playbook is the failure.
